英文法規名稱: Fee-charging Standards for National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts Library Card Applications
中文法規名稱: 國立臺灣美術館藝術圖書中心閱覽證收費標準
沿革內容:
1.Promulgated on December 16, 2005 (The Council of Cultural Affairs, Executive Yuan Wen-Jian-Tzu No. 0941129172)
2.Amended on September 10, 2025 (NTMoFA Guo-Mei-Tu-Zi No. 1143001227)

法規內容.條文內容: The Standards are decreed in accordance with the Charges and Fees Act stated in Article 10,Paragraph 1.
An application fee of NT$50 would be charged by National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts Art Library.
The Standards are executed since the date of promulgation.
